metadata.method: Public APIs only. One case and mode per process; rotate case and mode order. Rust reuses an independent warmed workspace per sample and retains previous workspaces until case end to sample multiple allocation layouts. C++ calls mapbox::earcut for every polygon, including its allocations and destruction. 500ms CPU warm-up and 3 per-sample warm-up calls excluded; input preparation excluded. Median of per-process sample medians; all samples retained. No target-cpu=native/-march=native flags added.
metadata.rust_source_note: Measured after the uncommitted upstream synchronization; source and snapshot hashes identify this version.
metadata.reporting: README compares public APIs: Earcut::earcut_slice with caller-owned reusable buffers, and mapbox::earcut with its per-call allocation and destruction included. Inputs are prebuilt. No sample exclusions or best-run selection.
